description: crowddynamics is a Python simulation environment for the movement of crowds, created in summer 2016 for the Systems Analysis Laboratory at Aalto University in Finland, with documentation hosted on GitHub Pages. It installs from source into a Conda environment and was tested on Ubuntu 16.04 with Python 3.6; a separate graphical interface built with Qt, pyqt and pyqtgraph visualises simulations and displays data interactively for designing and debugging scenarios. Coverage: generic. Access: free source code. Licence: MIT. Caveats: it was tested only on old Ubuntu and Python versions and appears to be a finished research project, not maintained software. Simulation uses: prototyping crowd movement and evacuation models in Python. Related records: Vadere and PEDSIM.
